request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, managed by Intersect using TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Mithril Protocol continuous development and Intersect budget administration.

claims.claim: Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way so nodes and applications can verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal says Mithril is fully aligned with Infrastructure & Research Excellence because state proofs strengthen cross-chain interoperability.
The proposal says faster sync times lower onboarding friction and unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, and monitoring.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not, at time of submission alone or in aggregate, breach the 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit and oversight costs are included in the proposal overhead, with Intersect and technically capable third parties providing reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs, while prior Mithril work was funded by IOG.
The budget allocates 3,699,440 ada to Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada to the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, and specified multisignature authorization thresholds.
A public dashboard is provided for the community to audit and track the withdrawn ada and related TRSC/PSSC metrics.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol development and administration, presents Mithril as decentralized infrastructure for rapid state verification, cites Intersect budget-process approval and NCL compliance, and describes smart-contract-based custody, oversight, and dashboard transparency.
